subject: Sample Corral: evaluation asset transfer & MAP
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@nimble-retail.com>; procurement@nimble-retail.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Sample Corral: evaluation asset transfer & MAP

Hi Elena —

Great to meet last week. As discussed, we've prepared a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) to exchange the evaluation corpus and prompt pack so your ML team can run a short benchmark against our latency/cost targets. High-level items we need to finalize:

- Asset list and manifest (we'll deliver a sanitized sample set)
- Access model: ephemeral cloud sandbox + token-limited API keys
- Usage constraints: no redistribution, retention = 90 days, only for benchmark/acceptance
- Acceptance gates and timeline (upload -> smoke tests -> acceptance)

I've attached a starter manifest (nimble_sample_manifest.csv) and a draft MAP workbook (MAP-Nimble-v1.xlsx). Proposed cadence:

1) 2026-10-20: Redwood uploads sample to secure bucket and shares ephemeral credentials
2) 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23: Your team runs benchmark suite (we'll provide runner + seed prompts)
3) 2026-10-25: Joint review; if pass -> acceptance & short-term license to run 30-day pilot

Constraints we need from your side: confirmation on who will have access (names + emails) and an explicit acknowledgement that the dataset is for evaluation only and will be deleted after 90 days.

Next steps: If that timeline looks feasible, I'll loop in Legal for a one-page term sheet and Ben (cc'd) will add minimal data handling clauses.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: nimble_sample_manifest.csv, MAP-Nimble-v1.xlsx
From: Elena Morales <elena@nimble-retail.com>

Cc: procurement@nimble-retail.com
Date: 2026-10-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sample Corral: evaluation asset transfer & MAP

Thanks Sean —

This looks reasonable. A couple quick items from my side:

- Can you confirm the sandbox will not log PII? Our legal team requires assurance of no persistent PII capture.
- We need to limit access to three people initially (me, our ML lead Marco, and procurement ops). I'll send names in a follow-up.
- Is there a short NDA or one-page term sheet we can sign to cover the exchange?

Procurement (procurement@nimble-retail.com) is on loop — they'll coordinate DocuSign.

— Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Data Science | Nimble Retail
elena@nimble-retail.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@nimble-retail.com
Date: 2026-10-20T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sample Corral: evaluation asset transfer & MAP

Elena —

Quick answers:
- Sandbox telemetry: Redwood's ephemeral evaluation sandboxes are configured to redact PII by default. We'll run an ingestion scrub on the manifest and provide a redaction report. No long-term logging of raw inputs unless you opt-in for diagnostics.
- Access: fine to limit to three named users — please confirm emails and we'll lock the keys to those identities.
- Term sheet: attached a concise term sheet (redwood-eval-term-sheet.pdf) in addition to the MAP workbook. Ben will suggest a short data-use clause below.

Proposed, slightly refined milestones (filled into MAP-Nimble-v1.xlsx):
- 2026-10-20 (today): Redwood places sample in secure bucket + shares one-time credentials
- 2026-10-21: Seed runner + prompt pack delivered; your team starts benchmark run (24–72h)
- 2026-10-24: Joint smoke review (30–45m)
- 2026-10-25: Acceptance decision and sign-off for 30-day pilot access if metrics met

I'll ask Ben to add the mandatory phrasing we need for the MAP. Laura will be available to help onboard your ML lead with the runner.

Regards,
Sean

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@nimble-retail.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sample Corral: evaluation asset transfer & MAP - legal snippet

Hi Elena and team —

Quick legal note and minimal data-handling language to include in the MAP (intended to keep the exchange lightweight):

1) Purpose-limited license: Nimble Retail will receive the evaluation dataset and prompt pack exclusively for the purposes of performing the benchmark and acceptance testing described in the MAP. No redistribution or commercial use.

2) Retention & deletion: Nimble agrees to delete all copies of the dataset and derivative artifacts within 90 days of acceptance or earlier if Redwood requests. Certification of deletion is acceptable via signed statement.

3) PII & telemetry: Redwood will not persist raw PII in logs for the ephemeral sandbox. Any telemetry used for debugging will be redacted and produced in aggregate on request.

4) Security controls: Access will be role-bound and restricted to the approved users; credentials are single-use and will be rotated after the onboarding window.

If Nimble is comfortable, we can add the above as a two-paragraph amendment to the MAP workbook (MAP-Nimble-v1.xlsx) and proceed to DocuSign. Otherwise, flag any specific language you need changed.

Ben Carter
Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
